title: 北京

series.next: 外公 calls: 小敏's mum is getting on a train to 北京. Tonight.

setting: A university campus in 北京, Wednesday, 9 am. 小敏 has to decide by Friday.

tongxue.name: 同学
tongxue.en: a student from your own town

steps.narr: 姨父 bought the two train tickets, and left them by her bowl. He said nothing.

else.en: I wanted to come and see for myself.

steps.narr: 北京. A campus gate. Heat, and a thousand bicycles.

steps.zh: 图书馆在哪儿啊？我想看看。
steps.en: Where's the library? I want to see it.

say.en: Ask a passer-by the way to the library.
answers: 不好意思，请问图书馆怎么走？
请问一下，去图书馆怎么走？
say.gloss: Excuse me, how do I get to the library?
say.tip: 请问 qǐngwèn = excuse me, may I ask: before any question to a stranger.

ok.en: Straight on. Left at the lake.

ok.narr: A lake. Willows. 小敏 stops at every building.

answers: 打扰一下，请问去图书馆怎么走最近？
打扰一下，请问图书馆怎么走最近？
4.gloss: Sorry to bother you: what's the quickest way to the library?
4.tip: 最近 zuì jìn = nearest, shortest: 怎么走最近？

steps.narr: On the library steps, a student hears you talking, and turns.

steps.zh: 听口音，你们是老家那边的吧？
steps.en: That accent: you're from back home, aren't you?

say.en: Yes! Ask if they're from your town too.
answers: 是啊！同学，你也是我们那儿的？
对！同学你也是我们那儿的吗？
say.gloss: Yes! Are you from our town too?
say.tip: 同学 tóngxué = what you call any student: no older, no younger, no he or she.

ok.en: I am! Three years in 北京 now.

ok.zh: 三年没回过家。票太难买了，习惯了。
ok.en: Haven't been home once. Tickets are impossible. You get used to it.

answers: 是啊，真巧！同学，你也是我们县的？
真巧，同学你也是我们县的吗？
4.gloss: Yes, what a coincidence! You're from our county too?

steps.en: Three years without going home... I couldn't.

say.en: Encourage her: take it slowly. There's time.
say.tip: 慢慢来 mànmàn lái = take your time, one step at a time.

answers: 慢慢来，到星期五还有两天呢。
慢慢来，离星期五还有两天呢。
4.gloss: Take it slowly. There are still two days till Friday.

steps.narr: Evening, by the lake. The willows, and the lights of the library.

steps.zh: 如果我来了，是不是就回不去了？
steps.en: If I come here... does that mean I can never go back?

say.en: Tell her far away isn't for ever, or that she doesn't have to know yet.
say.gloss: You can go far, and still come home.
say.tip: 再远 = however far: 走得再远，也能回家.

ok.en: Then you have to call me. Often.

alts.en: Or: she doesn't have to know yet
alts.gloss: It's all right not to know yet.

then.en: Mm. Then let's go and have roast duck first.

answers: 走得再远，想家了就能回家。
走得再远，随时都能回家。
4.gloss: However far you go, you can come home whenever you miss it.

answers: 还没想好也没关系，日子还长着呢。
没想好也没关系，日子还长。
alts.gloss: It's all right not to know yet. There's a lot of life ahead.

steps.en: That night 小敏 buys a 北京 keyring. For her dad. 🔑

else.en: Two days to Friday. 小敏 falls asleep with the campus map on her chest. 🗺️
